UPSSSC Forest Guard/ Wild Life Guard Eligibility Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the eligibility result for the recruitment of Forest Guard/ Wild Life Guard posts on the official website of UPSSSC. This recruitment was released for 708 posts. Applications for the UPSSSC Forest Guard/ Wild Life Guard Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 30 June 2026, to 22 July 2026. Candidates who had appeared in this Examination can download their UPSSSC Forest Guard/ Wild Life Guard Eligibility Result 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 30 June 2026
  • Last Date : 20 July 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 20 July 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 27 July 2026
  • Eligibility Result : 27 August 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST, Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • PH Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
